description: Sends a test copy of a draft to up to 3 addresses. The addresses must belong to users of this workspace; other addresses are refused. Uses quota only for the test emails actually sent, does not touch the audience, and does not change the draft. Offer this after campaign_preview so the person can check it in their own inbox. Requires API key scope: draft.

id.description: Campaign id (a UUID), as returned by campaign_draft or campaigns_list.

to.description: 1 to 3 addresses of people who use this workspace.

name: campaign_send_test
title: Send test email
